title: The Category Studio's engine
about: kategoria's script language (finite and presented categories, functors, limits, set-valued functors, monoidal theories) on morphe, compiled once with g++ 11 or later, natively or in WSL, into data/cache/engines/category-studio/. About two minutes; it is compiled again when its sources change. The studio needs no data.
